During the operation, hundreds of SDF fighters surrendered their weapons to ensure safe passage. This development is part of ongoing efforts to consolidate control over contested areas, with the Syrian army advancing eastward toward the city of Maskana.

These shifts reflect new dynamics in the regional conflict and its impact on the future of the area.
